'''Business and economy'''
*[[2020–2023 Chinese property sector crisis]]
**[[China|Chinese]] property developer [[Evergrande Group]] files for [[Chapter 15, Title 11, United States Code|chapter 15]] [[bankruptcy in the United States|bankruptcy protection]] in the [[United States]] as it works on a multi-billion dollar deal with [[creditors]] to [[Debt restructuring|restructure its debts]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-66540785 (BBC News)]
*In the [[Yellow Corporation]] bankruptcy proceeding, the court names financing lenders. Hedge funds [[Citadel LLC|Citadel]] and MFN Partners will together provide $142.5 million in debtor-in-possession (DIP) financing, which will give Yellow’s estate the funds necessary to liquidate assets. [https://www.reuters.com/business/autos-transportation/trucking-firm-estes-express-submits-13-bln-bid-yellows-shipment-centers-2023-08-17/ (Reuters)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 central Colombia earthquakes]]
**Two people are killed by a magnitude 6.3 [[list of earthquakes in Colombia|earthquake]] near [[Cumaral]], [[Meta Department]], [[Colombia]]. [https://www.infobae.com/colombia/2023/08/18/accidente-minero-cobro-la-vida-de-una-persona-tras-los-sismos-que-afectaron-a-colombia/ (Infobae)]
*[[2023 Pacific hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Hilary (2023)|Tropical Storm Hilary]] strengthens into a [[hurricane]] off the coast of [[Mexico]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/aug/17/hurricane-hilary-mexico (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Elmina plane crash]]
**In [[Malaysia]], a [[Beechcraft Premier I|Beechcraft 390]] travelling from [[Langkawi]] to [[Kuala Lumpur]] crashes into the [[Guthrie Corridor Expressway|Guthrie Highway]] in [[Elmina, Malaysia|Elmina]], [[Selangor]], killing all eight people on board as well as two people on the ground. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-66533412 (BBC News)]
*[[Wildfires in 2023]]
**[[2023 Canadian wildfires]]
***The city of [[Yellowknife]], [[Northwest Territories]], begins a complete [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] amid the spread of nearby [[wildfire|wildfires]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/north/nwt-wildfire-emergency-update-august-16-1.6938756 (CBC News)]
***Wildfires near [[Kelowna]], [[British Columbia]], cause the mandatory evacuation of over 2,400 properties and result in multiple structural losses. [https://www.kelownanow.com/watercooler/news/news/Wildfire/Nearly_5_000_properties_on_evac_alert_as_wildfire_north_of_West_Kelowna_grows_to_64_hectares/ (Kelowna Now)]
**[[2023 Hawaii wildfires]]
***In the United States, Herman Andaya resigns as [[Maui]]'s top emergency official amidst reproval for not activating the emergency sirens during the wildfires. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna100538 (NBC News)]
**More than 4,500 people in [[Tenerife]], [[Canary Islands]], [[Spain]], evacuate due to a wildfire burning over 2,600 hectares of the [[Teide National Park]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/thousands-evacuated-wildfire-spains-tenerife-island-rages-3705466 (Reuters via CNA)]

*The [[World Health Organization]] opens its first [[Summit (meeting)|summit]] on [[traditional medicine]] in [[Gandhinagar]], [[Gujarat]], [[India]]. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2023/08/17/world/science-health/who-traditional-medicine-summit/ (AFP via ''The Japan Times'')]

'''International relations'''

**[[Israel]] receives permission from the [[United States]] to sell its ''[[Arrow (missile family)|Arrow 3]]'' missile defense system to [[Germany]], according to the Israeli [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Defence Ministry]]. [https://www.faz.net/aktuell/politik/ausland/israel-und-usa-stimmen-verkauf-von-arrow-3-an-deutschland-zu-17935800.html (FAZ)]
*[[Iran–Saudi Arabia relations]]
**[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian Foreign Minister]] [[Hossein Amir-Abdollahian]] visits [[Saudi Arabia]] for the first time since the restoration of diplomatic relations. [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20230817-iran-s-fm-arrives-in-saudi-arabia-for-first-visit-since-ties-mended (AFP via France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Quran burnings in Sweden]]
**The [[Swedish Security Service]] raises [[Sweden|the country]]'s [[Terror alert system|terror alert level]] from "elevated" to "high", citing increased threats in response to the series of [[Quran desecration|Quran burnings]] in the country. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/sweden-heightens-terror-alert-after-koran-burnings-spy-agency/articleshow/102804739.cms (AFP via ''The Times of India'')]
*[[Corruption in Slovakia]]
**The former and current heads of Slovakia’s [[National Security Bureau (Slovakia)|spy agency]] and five other police and intelligence officers are being investigated for [[abuse of power]] and [[criminal conspiracy]] in two separate cases. [https://apnews.com/article/slovakia-police-intelligence-officers-charged-0b3eabe202cf930d649b4fd8ff72d06a (AP)]
*A [[Canadian]] woman is sentenced to nearly 22 years in prison in [[Washington, D.C.|Washington]] for mailing a threatening letter containing [[ricin]] to then-[[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] at the [[White House]]. [https://apnews.com/article/threatening-letter-ricin-donald-trump-white-house-canadian-10666b80df1c0beaf6c48bf4c453a47a (AP)]
